payload.role_in_assembly: This is the arithmetic core: after reduction to grid points, it gives the global upper bound and the unique equality case.

k ranges over integers from 1 through n inclusive
x ranges over all real numbers

floor(t) denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to t
root_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: Fix an integer n greater than 1 and define f(x) = floor(n x) minus the sum from k=1 to n of floor(k x) divided by k. The task is to determine the set of real numbers x such that for every real y, f(x) is greater than or equal to f(y), and to compute the corresponding maximum value m equal to f(x).
quantifier_order: for all integers n with n greater than 1
there exists a real number x that maximizes the expression
for all real numbers y, the expression at x is greater than or equal to the expression at y

semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For a fixed parameter n (intended n >= 1), for every integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, the value F_n(j/n) is at most H_n minus 1, and F_n(j/n) equals H_n minus 1 exactly when j equals n minus 1.
quantifier_order: for all j (integer), with 0 <= j <= n - 1

variables.name: n
variables.role: parameter indexing the functions F_n and the value H_n; also determines the range 0 <= j <= n - 1

variables.name: j
variables.role: loop variable ranging over the integer indices in 0 <= j <= n - 1

witness_dependencies: the equality case is pinned by the specific witness value j = n - 1; no separate existential witness is introduced beyond this equivalence condition

payload.statement_nl: For every integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, F_n(j/n) <= H_n - 1, and equality holds if and only if j = n - 1.
